However, if Kay is under the cherry tree (as stated in Testimony 3), she would be behind the candy stand from the perspective of someone coming from beyond the concession stand. This creates a spatial contradiction - she cannot simultaneously be under the cherry tree (behind the candy stand) and in front of the candy stand when seeing the red figure.
